summary: Use literal nonsecret YAML rather than properties or placeholders, and add three native application modules: annual membership and renewal management with actual email one calendar month before expiry (WeChat optional), an encrypted vault for the user's own platform passwords, and open-source-referenced multi-format personal notes. Reuse existing persistent local UI workflows without changing the preview/backend boundary. Local-only execution is a parent decision, not a user selection, and does not fulfill unattended real email delivery.
rawUserRequest: /joycode-2 joycode 配置要用yml，不要用properties，不要占位符，直接写入文件。增加三个模块：会员管理，负责登记每年开通的各种会员，到期前一个月进行邮件通知(能微信通知最好)。密码管理，负责管理我自己的各个平台密码。笔记管理，参考开源的笔记管理平台，可以自己记一些内容，多种形式记录。
acceptanceCriteria: PT-01: Literal nonsecret YAML replaces properties and placeholders while preserving security, namespace, profile and fail-closed defaults.
PT-02: Persistent annual membership CRUD, renewal history, amounts, destinations and expiry filtering.
PT-03: Calendar-month-before reminders with clamping and deduplication; real email remains required and unverified without a provider, WeChat optional.
PT-04: Proven-library encrypted personal vault with unlock/lock, safe reveal/copy, encrypted persistence/backup and failure-safe restore.
PT-05: Persistent independent rich-text/Markdown notes with tags/search/archive, safe images/attachments and import/export.
PT-06: Three native Art Design Pro menu/routes and usable desktop/mobile flows without resetting existing data or changing the backend-preview boundary.
PT-07: Real focused/full tests and independent/browser evidence; missing live notifications stay honestly degraded.
PT-08: User addendum requires com.deeplazy.bingo root and controller/service/entity/mapper layers, matching current source/test directories, preserved framework scanning and no fake business classes.

acceptanceDetails.description: Replace application, smoke and test properties with semantically equivalent .yml configuration containing direct non-sensitive values, not environment placeholders. Preserve bingo_ table and Redis prefixes, Redis DB 3, TLS defaults, disabled migrations/model integration, deny-by-default endpoints and existing tests. No active plaintext password may be written; absent credentials fail closed rather than pretending a connection succeeded.
acceptanceDetails.verification: Later implementation must test configuration binding and security defaults for all three profiles, check removal of replaced properties and placeholder/credential absence, and run existing relevant tests. No configuration or secret contents were inspected in this understand dispatch.

acceptanceDetails.description: Create, edit and archive annual memberships while preserving distinct historical renewal periods. Record service, date range, cost/currency, account label and reminder destination; filter expiry states and retain records after refresh.
acceptanceDetails.verification: Later focused tests and browser checks must cover CRUD, renewal-period separation, expiry filtering and refresh persistence without resetting existing local data.

acceptanceDetails.description: Compute reminders one calendar month before expiry, clamping to the last valid calendar day. Show overdue unsent reminders and deduplicate per membership period/channel. Actual email delivery is required; WeChat is optional. Only a genuine provider receipt can establish successful delivery. Missing credentials and browser-closure scheduling limits must be explicit.
acceptanceDetails.verification: Later tests must cover month-end/leap-year dates, overdue visibility, channel/period deduplication and failure/receipt states. Do not send real messages in this run. Local computation or an in-app reminder cannot pass actual email or unattended delivery acceptance.
acceptanceDetails.unmet: SMTP provider, approved sender/recipient policy, safe credentials, authorized live test and a persistent scheduler are not supplied or authorized. WeChat channel and credentials are also absent.

acceptanceDetails.description: Provide a personal vault for platform/account/password/URL/notes records with unlock/lock, safe reveal/copy, refresh-safe encrypted persistence and encrypted backup/restore. Use a proven existing vault/crypto library, never home-grown cryptography. Never persist the master password, plaintext entries, derived key or decrypted backup. Idle/visibility locking and failed unlock/import must preserve existing data.
acceptanceDetails.verification: Later tests must cover correct/incorrect unlock, lock and visibility/idle behavior, ciphertext-only persisted records and backups, restore validation, and preservation of existing ciphertext on failures. Safe manual unlock input stays outside model-visible tools; no real user passwords are required for testing.

acceptanceDetails.description: Provide independent personal notes with create/edit/search/tags/archive, meaningful rich-text and Markdown workflows, safe images/attachments, export/import, refresh persistence and unsaved/error states. Reference established open-source note platforms and reuse maintained open-source editor packages with license compliance. Sanitize rendered user content; do not copy hosted application source or proprietary assets.
acceptanceDetails.verification: Later focused tests and browser checks must exercise both editing formats, import/export, search/tags/archive, safe attachment handling, sanitization, refresh and unsaved/error recovery. Learning-linked notes alone do not satisfy independent notes.

acceptanceDetails.description: Expose all three modules through the existing Art Design Pro menu/routes and native icon/component conventions. Desktop and mobile controls must be usable without overlap. Preserve previous local databases and the existing preview-to-backend capability boundary; front-end navigation is not authorization.
acceptanceDetails.verification: Later route/menu and browser checks must exercise all three workflows on desktop and mobile, persistence preservation and preview/backend separation without granting new backend access.

acceptanceDetails.description: Write focused tests before implementation, keep existing full suites/builds green, and record actual commands, exit codes, tested snapshot and browser workflow evidence through the parent-owned verification handoff. Missing SMTP/WeChat delivery remains explicitly degraded, never PASS.
acceptanceDetails.verification: Implementation must run focused tests and existing full checks against an identified snapshot; the parent owns independent verification and runtime registration. This understand dispatch runs only report validation, not product tests or delivery verification.

assumptions.statement: The choice interaction was reported unavailable by the parent. Proceed L1 standard, local-only, without treating any option as selected by the user.
Direct YAML means literal nonsecret values, not permission to write plaintext credentials. Never recover earlier passwords or bypass a blocked configuration write through another API.

Reuse existing persistent local UI workflows for the first increment. Do not invent backend authentication, multi-device synchronization or unattended notification capability. An encrypted vault needs a dedicated boundary instead of plaintext generic module records.
Email remains required and WeChat optional. Missing live inputs permit honest degradation only, never deletion of the original requirement or a successful-delivery claim.
Prior dirty backend/frontend work is user-owned and must remain intact. The only permitted write in this dispatch is this ordinary understanding report.
